_note: PUT this to /v2/acts/{actorId} as a pricingInfos array entry. PAY_PER_EVENT only on BRONZE. startedAt must be 14+ days out. Apify auto-adds 20% margin. This actor is plain HTTP (CheerioCrawler, no browser), so compute per lead is tiny and these prices stay well above it. High volume, so prices are set low. First 10 qualified_lead per run are free for validation.

listing.eventDescription: One app with developer name, category, install band, rating, and monetization flags, but no public developer email.

lead.eventDescription: One app whose listing publishes a developer contact email, plus developer name, website where available, category, installs, and rating.

qualified_lead.eventDescription: An app with a developer contact email, a developer website, and installs at or above the qualified bar. A reachable, established developer. The first 10 qualified_lead per run are free so you can validate output.
